entities.name: Matylda Matoušková-Šínová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Matylda Růžičková-Šínová was a Czech gymnast who competed for Czechoslovakia in the 1952 Summer Olympics, in the 1956 Summer Olympics, and in the 1960 Summer Olympics. After her active career, she was a university teacher in the field of physical education.
